justifications.fit: the reader edits keep the one-line predicate shape of reckon/ledger.py:3990 and the new cases extend the existing test module beside its `_store` helper, with `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` clean on both changed source paths.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:3990, :4002, :4473 and :4644 all take the plan from `_row_plan`, and the flat `record.get("plan")` survives only at :1695 inside the resolver that owns it.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no production definition — it routes three readers through the existing `_row_plan` at reckon/ledger.py:1675 — and a search of reckon/ for another plan-resolution owner found only that resolver, the out-of-scope readers the manifest names, and no second mechanism to extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: the three paths in the diff are inside the declared write paths, and reckon/mcp_views.py, which the fence allowed, needed no edit because reckon/mcp_views.py:4931 only passes a plan to the repaired filter.
